name: Ayasaki Nanaka
source:
The childhood friend of the Kazama siblings. A shy girl who doesn't stand out and cries easily, but also has a bright personality. Was often bullied when she was younger, but was always protected by [url=/c47705]Iori[/url] whom Nanaka is attached to like glue.

[spoiler]Her fetishes are sex in public spaces and being watched.
